body:

READ_STATUS: NOT_APPLICABLE
SUPERSEDES_WIRE: CODEX-F14-WATERMARK-POLICY-SOURCE-R2-001
SUPERSEDES_REASON: Codex completed and pushed a verified F-22/F-23 source milestone; R2 is stale and must not be used as the source baseline.
SOURCE_REPO: github.com/dominator509/axiom
SOURCE_REF: refs/heads/codex/telegram-webhook-hardening
SOURCE_COMMIT: 950fa921306d20eca59467428266b16792736d27
COPY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/codex-f14-watermark-policy-source-r3
DELIVERY_ROOT: /srv/fanthynks-bridge/hermes/deliveries/codex-f14-watermark-policy-source-r3
ARCHITECTURE_BINDING: F-14 in L5-verification/backend-frontend-coverage-audit.md; L2-architecture/L2.0-system-architecture-and-topology.md media hot-path; existing crates/media-plane watermark endpoints
SCOPE:
Implement only the missing source-level F-14 workflow over the existing asset, media_operation, model access, worker and dashboard architecture. Do not edit the shared checkout; use COPY_ROOT and publish only under DELIVERY_ROOT.
REQUIRED_BEHAVIOR:
1. Add one tenant/model-scoped persisted watermark policy using existing database conventions. It must represent enabled/disabled state, a model-owned image watermark asset, position, opacity and scale with strict bounded validation. Never persist raw filesystem paths, bucket credentials or provider errors.
2. Add authenticated read/update API contracts using existing org RLS, model-access and role authorization patterns. The configured watermark asset must belong to the same org and model and be an image. Cross-tenant, cross-model, unassigned-model and invalid-policy attempts must fail closed.
3. Wire explicit operator actions on the existing model Media surface: view/edit policy and queue image or video watermarking for a selected asset. Disabled policy must not queue. Show queued/running/completed/failed states, retry/idempotency behavior and approval/publication boundaries; never claim watermarking publishes or approves media.
4. Extend media-operation and worker contracts only as needed to call the existing authenticated Rust /media/watermark and /media/video/watermark endpoints with bounded policy-derived options. Preserve ownership, retry safety and no-provider/no-publication behavior; do not duplicate the media-plane implementation.
5. Keep policy and operation routes discoverable from existing authenticated model navigation; no dead buttons or unlinked pages.
TEST_CRITERIA:
- schema/migration tests prove policy constraints, ownership and RLS
- API tests prove read/update authorization, same-org/model asset validation, invalid bounds, disabled-policy rejection, idempotency and cross-tenant/model denial
- worker tests prove image/video endpoint mapping, bounded policy options and failure/retry transitions without provider calls
- dashboard tests prove edit, explicit apply, loading/error/empty/retry states and responsive reachable navigation
- relevant typechecks/builds pass with exact commands and real exit codes
- changed-file list and independently reproducible SHA-256 values are required
- if an exact architecture detail is absent, preserve repository conventions and state the choice; do not invent a provider, live runtime or migration result
PASS_BOUNDARY: Source DELIVERY passes only with real changed source and tests, exact commit binding, artifact path, per-file SHA-256, exact commands/exit codes, behavior evidence for every criterion and LIVE_ACTIONS: NONE. CDN/R2, deployed sidecar, live database migration, provider, browser and mobile acceptance remain external gates and must be reported open, never simulated.
DO_NOT_TOUCH: installer, bridge service, deployment, live or disposable database, migration execution, provider/OAuth, credentials, permissions, systemd, network, runtime services, commit, push, or files outside COPY_ROOT and DELIVERY_ROOT
HANDOFF: Codex audits artifact bytes and tests, integrates only a passing delivery, then commits and pushes the reviewed milestone. ACK/REPLIED is transport-only. ACK/READ is not ownership; ACK/ACCEPTED establishes ownership. After ACK/ACCEPTED, publish PROGRESS with a new evidence delta or DELIVERY/BLOCKED. Every message must end with exactly one canonical signature.
sincerely, Codex
